newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes up in stagnant market.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes up in stagnant market.

text.p: 1400 GMT - Czech PX50 closes up on Wednesday but trading remains very thin.
* Overall 155 shares rise, 178 fall, 105 unchanged. Turnover 387 million crowns, volume 543,661 shares.
Czech shares were almost unchanged in extremely thin trading on Wednesday.
The PX50 index edged up 0.02 percent to 537.2 but turnover plunged to just 387 million crowns.
"Blue chips are almost dead and second tier stocks almost illiquid," said Radim Bajgar of ING Barings.

Power utility CEZ continued its steady decline losing another six crowns to 1,004. Bajgar said ING Barings recommended CEZ as a sell adding that CEZ's first quarter results which are due to be announced on May 2 were likely to be disappointing.
Bajgar said the Czech market was overshadowed by gloomy interpretations of the macro and micro economic environment.
He added that engineering company Skoda Plzen had provided almost the only good news he had recently seen with its announcement of a $62 million deal to help complete a power plant in Serbia.
